cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the meeting from here. Before you leave, tell the room I'm the person who decides the next item.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're already sitting in my chair. Isn't that enough?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The seat's settled; the authority needs saying. Use your own words, and I'll keep the handover brief.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. You're chairing. I've got to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say that facing them, with 'Jo decides whether we vote now.' You can say it as you pick up your coat. I'll follow your lead for that one sentence, then handle the room.
